title: Portal customer state requires explicit stored non-stale ACK and authenticated GET readback
root_cause: Portal V2 client rejected only stored===false for /api/portal-state POST; HTTP 200 with missing stored or stale:true could proceed to load(), masking an incomplete projection write after canonical BusinessInput source ACK.
impact: Customer-facing saved status could be displayed despite an incomplete or obsolete tenant-scoped Portal State projection, so later dashboard and Brain views could disagree. No verified real customer corruption is claimed.
fix: For original Portal State client, require stored===true and stale===false plus authenticated GET readback. Fail closed with original domain-state error and existing server handoff journal. No duplicate writer.
prevention_rule: Customer input write is complete only after original authoritative BusinessInput+organism source ACK and explicit current Portal State non-stale ACK and tenant-authenticated GET. Missing/stale is never saved, executed or learned.
owner: original Portal V2 customer input and ONE BRAIN source authority
evidence: Read original code at protected main e3802eb074c9d6fcd502574ef715f46223930470 with condition `!response.ok||body?.stored===false`
Original browser client save response otherwise treated 200 as valid and skipped check of stale true or omitted stored
Fix guards client success; independent live tenant field-to-outcome and external updates require future verification
outcome: FIX_CANDIDATE — protected PR and production authenticated data update/readback still required. Do not close #4215 or count external CRO outcomes.
